'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel]]i [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Defense Minister]] [[Benny Gantz]] says he has instructed the [[Israel Defense Forces]] to prepare military options for potential use against [[Iran]], that the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]] yielded "no progress", and that world powers "understand that the Iranians are playing games". [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/.premium-israeli-army-has-been-instructed-to-prepare-military-option-against-iran-gantz-says-1.10457857 (''Haaretz'')]
*The [[Gulf Cooperation Council]] calls for [[Iran]] to take action to salvage the nuclear deal and proposes to take part in the talks as a regional power. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gulf-summit-aims-signal-solidarity-amid-iran-tension-2021-12-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornado outbreak of December 10–11, 2021]]
**The death toll from the [[Tornado outbreak of December 10–11, 2021|tornado outbreak]] in [[Kentucky]], United States, increases to 70 and will likely continue to increase as more bodies are counted, according to a statement from [[Governor of Kentucky|Governor]] [[Andy Beshear]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tornadoes-kentucky-illinois-arkansas-severe-weather-67b9acfb9d83e2e7139ae9de01618a21 (AP)]
*[[2021 Ravanusa explosion]]
**Seven people are dead and two more missing after a residential building explodes and collapses due to a [[gas leak]] in [[Ravanusa]], [[Province of Agrigento|Agrigento]], [[Sicily]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59636399 (BBC News)]
*[[Storm Barra]]
**Two deaths are reported in [[Navarre]] due to flooding in northern Spain. [https://www.abc.es/sociedad/abci-nuevo-desaparecido-y-riadas-historicas-esta-dejando-temporal-provocado-borrasca-barra-202112111040_noticia.html?ref=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F (ABC.es)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] reports its first cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in two female cricketers of the [[Bangladesh Cricket Team]] who travelled from [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/covid-19-bangladesh-reports-first-case-of-omicron-variant20211211193535 (Asian News International)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 80 deaths from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 4,210. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20211211000027 (''The Korea Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] reports its first cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in three people who travelled from the [[United Kingdom]], [[Eswatini]], and the United States. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taiwan-confirms-first-case-omicron-variant-2021-12-11/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malta]]
****[[Malta]] reimposes one of the [[European Union|EU]]'s strictest [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandates]] that requires people to wear masks outdoors, with fines of [[Euro|€]]50 to [[Euro|€]]100 for failure to comply. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/its-official-anyone-over-the-age-of-three-must-wear-a-mask-outdoors.920665 (''Times of Malta'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports its first six cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in five people from the [[Izmir Province|province of Izmir]] and one person from [[Istanbul]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/turkey/turkey-registers-first-omicron-variant-cases-52547 (TRT World)] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Uruguay]]
***At midnight, terrestrial transport between [[Argentina]] and [[Uruguay]] reopens as buses resume service to [[Argentina–Uruguay border|border]] crossings between the two countries. Both countries require a proof of [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccination]] or a negative [[COVID-19 test]] in order to board the buses and enter both countries. [https://misionescuatro.com/nacionales/vuelven-a-funcionar-los-omnibus-de-larga-distancia-entre-argentina-y-uruguay/ (Misiones Cuatro)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mauritius]]
***[[Mauritius]] reports its first cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in two people who travelled from [[South Africa]]. [https://dailytimes.com.pk/853626/mauritius-records-first-two-omicron-cases-more-feared/ (''Daily Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Benin]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] opposition leader [[Reckya Madougou]] to 20 years in prison after finding her guilty of "financing [[terrorism]]". The case has been highly controversial, with a judge in the case fleeing to [[France]] and denouncing the case as "entirely politically motivated". [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2021/12/10/benin-opposition-reckya-madougou/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[MLS Cup 2021]]
**[[New York City FC]] defeats the [[Portland Timbers]] 4–2 in a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]], winning their first title. [https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/622709 (ESPN)]
